name: Grapploct
description: Grapploct, the Jujitsu Pokémon, and the evolved form of Clobbopus. A Fighting type.
pokedex_entries: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
